body.text: CleanCut Auto Shield is a Portland based automotive protection and restyling studio specializing in paint protection film, ceramic car coatings, window tint and vinyl wraps. We are a small team of dedicated artists that take pride in not only protecting vehicles, but adding personalized style and flare.
